## General info about the code ##
# This script contains the NMF visualization workflow adapted from
# Konstantina's original code for figure generation in the manuscript.
# The modifications mainly concern plot layout, ordering of components
# and sample groups, color handling, and text sizing to improve
# readability and consistency in publication figures.
#
# MERGE NOTE (this pass): this script combines TWO earlier versions.
# One version had improved/refactored visualization functions
# (build_nmf_tables, plotLoadings_A4, cleaner group color handling) but
# was MISSING several steps present in the original: the cosine
# similarity heatmap between factors, collapsing the 30 factors into
# broader biological composition classes, the spatial dominant-class
# map, and -- critically -- the final save of Integrated_NMF.rds, which
# is the file every other script in this entire project reads as its
# primary input. Those missing sections have been restored here
# (Sections 8-11 below), using the original's exact composition-class
# gene/factor index mappings unchanged, since those reflect manually
# curated biological interpretation that must not be altered silently.
#
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT PRODUCES
# --------------------------
# Tables (output/02_NMF_visualization/tables/):
#   - NMF_top200_genes_long.csv
#       Top 200 genes per NMF factor, long format, for supplementary
#       material / manual annotation (Table S2).
#   - NMF_genes.csv
#       Full gene loading matrix (W), all factors, all genes.
#   - NMFcomp.csv
#       Spot-level collapsed composition (30 factors -> biological
#       classes: CAF, Ductal_malignant, B_cells, etc.), percent scale.
#
# Figures (output/02_NMF_visualization/figures/):
#   - FigureS3_all_factor_loadings.pdf
#       Figure S3. Gene loading plots for ALL 30 NMF factors.
#   - Figure1C_D_loadings_selected_factors.pdf
#       Figures 1C and 1D. Gene loading plots for the 5
#       manuscript-highlighted factors (tumour + nerve associated).
#   - exploratory_representation_all_factors.pdf
#       Representation of all 30 factors across tissue blocks.
#       NOT in the manuscript.
#   - Figure1E_representation_selected.pdf
#       Figure 1E. Representation of the 5 highlighted factors,
#       patient/status-ordered stacking.
#   - FigureS4B_activity_per_spot.pdf
#       Figure S4B. Mean NMF activity per spot, tumour- vs
#       nerve-associated factors in separate panels.
#   - FigureS4A_factor_similarity_heatmap.pdf
#       Figure S4A. Cosine similarity between all 30 factors' gene
#       loadings -- assesses factor redundancy.
#   - FigureS4C_spatial_dominant_class.png
#       Figure S4C. Spatial map of the dominant collapsed biological
#       class per spot, one representative sample.
#
# Anything named "exploratory_" is not in the manuscript.
#
# Processed / Input handoff:
#   - output/.../Integrated_NMF.rds is NOT where this lands -- the
#     final annotated spe object is saved directly to input/, since
#     every downstream script in this project treats
#     Integrated_NMF.rds as a fixed input file, not a per-analysis
#     result (same convention as um_per_pixel_CALIBRATED.rds).
# ============================================================

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# 2. Helper functions for NMF table building and plotting
# ============================================================

lighten_hex <- function(col, amount = 0.55) {
  rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(col)
  rgb2 <- rgb + (255 - rgb) * amount
  grDevices::rgb(rgb2[1,]/255, rgb2[2,]/255, rgb2[3,]/255)
}

build_nmf_tables <- function(out, spe, rename_map,
                             patient_cols = c("P1"="#E31A1C","P2"="green4","P3"="dodgerblue2")) {

  # --- W + H (scale-aware) ---
  w <- out@w
  colnames(w) <- sub("^nmf", "NMF_", colnames(w))

  H <- out@h
  H <- sweep(H, 1, out@d, `*`)
  rn <- rownames(H)
  rn <- sub("^nmf(\\d+)$", "NMF_\\1", rn, perl = TRUE)
  rownames(H) <- rn

  # --- map each spot/cell -> sample_id ---
  # IMPORTANT: assumes rownames(t(H)) match spe$barcode
  df <- as.data.frame(t(H))
  df$barcode <- rownames(df)

  map_barcode_to_sample <- tibble(
    barcode   = spe$barcode,
    sample_id = spe$sample_id
  )

  df <- df %>%
    left_join(map_barcode_to_sample, by = "barcode")

  # --- rename sample_id to your nice group labels ---
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(group = unname(rename_map[as.character(sample_id)]))

  # --- long exposures summed per (component, group) ---
  long_sum <- df %>%
    select(-barcode, -sample_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(-group, names_to = "component", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(component, group) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # --- proportions per component ---
  long_prop <- long_sum %>%
    group_by(component) %>%
    mutate(prop = value / sum(value)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # --- order components by numeric id (descending for coord_flip) ---
  long_prop <- long_prop %>%
    mutate(nmf_num = as.numeric(sub("^NMF_", "", component))) %>%
    arrange(nmf_num) %>%
    mutate(component = factor(component, levels = rev(unique(component))))

  # --- annotate group -> patient/status ---
  group_info <- long_prop %>%
    distinct(group) %>%
    mutate(
      patient = str_extract(group, "Patient\\s*\\d+"),
      patient = str_replace(patient, "Patient\\s*", "P"),
      status  = case_when(
        str_detect(group, regex("adjacent", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Adjacent",
        str_detect(group, regex("diseased", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Diseased",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      patient = factor(patient, levels = c("P1","P2","P3")),
      status  = factor(status, levels = c("Diseased","Adjacent","Other"))
    )

  # --- group fill colors: strong for diseased, light for adjacent ---
  group_fill_vals <- setNames(
    vapply(seq_len(nrow(group_info)), function(i) {
      base <- patient_cols[as.character(group_info$patient[i])]
      if (is.na(base)) base <- "grey60"
      if (as.character(group_info$status[i]) == "Adjacent") lighten_hex(base, 0.55) else base
    }, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
    group_info$group
  )

  # --- spot counts per renamed group (for mean-per-spot plots) ---
  spot_counts <- as.data.frame(table(spe$sample_id))
  colnames(spot_counts) <- c("sample_id", "n_spots")

  map_df <- tibble(
    sample_id = names(rename_map),
    group     = unname(rename_map)
  )

  spot_counts_group <- map_df %>%
    left_join(spot_counts, by = "sample_id") %>%
    select(group, n_spots)

  # --- long_abs: add n_spots and per-spot activity ---
  long_abs <- long_sum %>%
    left_join(spot_counts_group, by = "group") %>%
    mutate(value_per_spot = value / n_spots) %>%
    left_join(group_info, by = "group")

  list(
    w = w,
    H = H,
    long_prop = long_prop,
    long_abs  = long_abs,
    group_info = group_info,
    group_fill_vals = group_fill_vals
  )
}

# Robust loadings
plotLoadings <- function(amp, n = 15,
                         gene_size = 7,
                         title_size = 8,
                         ncol = 5) {

  # Ensure genes are rows, factors are columns
  if (nrow(amp) < ncol(amp)) amp <- t(amp)

  if (is.null(colnames(amp))) colnames(amp) <- paste0("Factor ", seq_len(ncol(amp)))
  if (is.null(rownames(amp))) stop("Supply gene names as rownames(amp).")

  K <- ncol(amp)
  if (is.null(ncol)) ncol <- min(5, K)
  nrow_grid <- ceiling(K / ncol)

  plist <- vector("list", K)

  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    nm  <- colnames(amp)[k]
    vmin <- min(amp[, k], na.rm = TRUE)
vmax <- max(amp[, k], na.rm = TRUE)
if (isTRUE(all.equal(vmin, vmax))) {
  sc <- rep(0, nrow(amp))
  names(sc) <- rownames(amp)
} else {
  sc <- (amp[, k] - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)
}
    ord <- sort(sc, decreasing = TRUE)
    ord <- head(ord, n)

    fp <- data.frame(
      Gene  = factor(names(ord), levels = rev(names(ord))),
      Value = as.numeric(ord)
    )

    plist[[k]] <- ggplot(fp, aes(x = Gene, y = Value)) +
      geom_segment(aes(xend = Gene, y = 0, yend = Value), linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_point(size = 3.6, pch = 21, fill = "steelblue", color = "grey20") +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
      labs(title = nm, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = gene_size) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title  = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = gene_size),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = gene_size),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
        plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6)
      )
  }

  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plist, ncol = ncol, nrow = nrow_grid)
}

plotLoadings_A4 <- function(amp, n = 15,
                            gene_size = 7,
                            title_size = 8,
                            ncol = 5,
                            panel_spacing = 1.2) {

  if (nrow(amp) < ncol(amp)) amp <- t(amp)

  if (is.null(colnames(amp))) colnames(amp) <- paste0("Factor ", seq_len(ncol(amp)))
  if (is.null(rownames(amp))) stop("Supply gene names as rownames(amp).")

  K <- ncol(amp)
  nrow_grid <- ceiling(K / ncol)

  plist <- vector("list", K)

  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    nm <- colnames(amp)[k]

    vmin <- min(amp[, k], na.rm = TRUE)
    vmax <- max(amp[, k], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (isTRUE(all.equal(vmin, vmax))) {
      sc <- rep(0, nrow(amp))
      names(sc) <- rownames(amp)
    } else {
      sc <- (amp[, k] - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)
    }

    ord <- sort(sc, decreasing = TRUE)
    ord <- head(ord, n)

    df <- data.frame(
      Gene  = factor(names(ord), levels = rev(names(ord))),
      Value = as.numeric(ord)
    )

    plist[[k]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Gene, y = Value)) +
      geom_segment(aes(xend = Gene, y = 0, yend = Value), linewidth = 0.35) +
      geom_point(size = 3.6, shape = 21, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, 1.05),
        breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
      ) +
      labs(title = nm) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = gene_size) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = gene_size),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = gene_size),
        axis.title  = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
      )
  }

  cowplot::plot_grid(
    plotlist = plist,
    ncol = ncol,
    nrow = nrow_grid,
    rel_heights = rep(panel_spacing, nrow_grid)
  )
}

# NOTE: not called by default in this script -- kept as an available
# helper for optional additional supplementary panels (e.g. spot
# composition by invasion status), matching the original's intent.
plot_spot_composition_2x2 <- function(spe,
                                      panel_var,
                                      tissue_var,
                                      patient_var,
                                      nerve_id_var,
                                      panels = c("Invaded", "Uninvaded", "Tumor proximal", "Tumor distal"),
                                      tissue_levels = c("Diseased","Adjacent"),
                                      patient_cols = c("P1"="#E31A1C","P2"="green4","P3"="dodgerblue2"),
                                      base_size = 13) {

  df <- as.data.frame(colData(spe))

  need <- c(panel_var, tissue_var, patient_var, nerve_id_var)
  stopifnot(all(need %in% colnames(df)))

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data[[panel_var]]),
      !is.na(.data[[tissue_var]]),
      !is.na(.data[[patient_var]])
    )

  df[[patient_var]] <- as.character(df[[patient_var]])
  df[[patient_var]] <- stringr::str_replace(df[[patient_var]], "Patient\\s*", "P")

  df[[panel_var]]  <- factor(df[[panel_var]], levels = panels)
  df[[tissue_var]] <- factor(df[[tissue_var]], levels = tissue_levels)
  df[[patient_var]] <- factor(df[[patient_var]], levels = names(patient_cols))

  spot_tab <- df %>%
    dplyr::count(
      panel = .data[[panel_var]],
      tissue = .data[[tissue_var]],
      patient = .data[[patient_var]],
      name = "n_spots"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(panel), !is.na(tissue), !is.na(patient))

  nerve_tab <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[nerve_id_var]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(panel = .data[[panel_var]]) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(panel) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_nerves = dplyr::n_distinct(.data[[nerve_id_var]]), .groups = "drop")

  y_max <- spot_tab %>%
    dplyr::group_by(panel) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(y = max(n_spots, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(nerve_tab, by = "panel") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      y = ifelse(is.finite(y), y * 1.08, 0),
      label = paste0("Nerves: ", n_nerves)
    )

  ggplot(spot_tab, aes(x = tissue, y = n_spots, fill = patient)) +
    geom_col(position = position_stack(), width = 0.78, color = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = patient_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    geom_text(
      data = y_max,
      aes(x = tissue_levels[2], y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0,
      size = 3.8
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of spots", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 4. Plot NMF factor representation across tissue blocks (all factors)
# ============================================================

plot_representation_all <- function(long_prop, group_fill_vals, base_size = 14) {
  ggplot(long_prop, aes(x = component, y = prop, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.01), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_fill_vals) +
    labs(title = "Representation in tissue block", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

p1 <- plot_representation_all(res$long_prop, res$group_fill_vals, base_size = 14)
print(p1)
# Exploratory: built but not used in the manuscript.
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_representation_all_factors.pdf"), p1, width = 8, height = 10)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 4B. Plot selected NMF factor representation across tissue blocks
# ============================================================

plot_representation_keep_stack <- function(long_prop, keep,
                                          group_fill_vals,
                                          base_size = 22,
                                          order_stack = c("Diseased","Adjacent","Other"),
                                          order_patient = c("P1","P2","P3")) {

  dat <- long_prop %>%
    filter(component %in% keep) %>%
    mutate(component = factor(component, levels = keep)) %>%
    left_join(
      long_prop %>% distinct(group) %>%
        mutate(
          patient = str_replace(str_extract(group, "Patient\\s*\\d+"), "Patient\\s*", "P"),
          status  = case_when(
            str_detect(group, regex("adjacent", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Adjacent",
            str_detect(group, regex("diseased", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Diseased",
            TRUE ~ "Other"
          ),
          patient = factor(patient, levels = order_patient),
          status  = factor(status, levels = order_stack)
        ),
      by = "group"
    )

  group_levels_stack <- dat %>%
    distinct(group, patient, status) %>%
    mutate(
      status_rank  = as.integer(status),
      patient_rank = as.integer(patient),
      stack_rank = status_rank * 10L + patient_rank
    ) %>%
    arrange(stack_rank, group) %>%
    pull(group)

  dat$group <- factor(dat$group, levels = group_levels_stack)

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = component, y = prop, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_fill_vals) +
    labs(title = "Representation in tissue block", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

keep5 <- c("NMF_27","NMF_19","NMF_14","NMF_13","NMF_4")
p2_vs2 <- plot_representation_keep_stack(res$long_prop, keep5, res$group_fill_vals, base_size = 22)
print(p2_vs2)
# BUGFIX: this plot was previously built but never saved to disk.
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure1E_representation_selected.pdf"), p2_vs2, width = 14, height = 4)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5. Plot mean NMF activity per spot for selected factors
# ============================================================

plot_abs_split <- function(long_abs, keep, nerve_keep,
                           comp_cols,
                           base_size = 14) {

  dat <- long_abs %>%
    filter(component %in% keep) %>%
    mutate(component = factor(component, levels = keep))

  tumor_keep <- setdiff(keep, nerve_keep)

  p_tumor <- dat %>%
    filter(component %in% tumor_keep) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = group, y = value_per_spot, fill = component)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.85) +
    facet_grid(~ status, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = comp_cols) +
    labs(title = "NMF component activity per block (mean per spot)",
         x = NULL, y = "Mean NMF activity per spot") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size),
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )

  p_nerve <- dat %>%
    filter(component %in% nerve_keep) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = group, y = value_per_spot, fill = component)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.85) +
    facet_grid(~ status, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = comp_cols) +
    labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "Mean NMF activity per spot") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size),
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )

  p_tumor / p_nerve + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))
}

comp_cols <- c(
  "NMF_4"  = "#1b9e77",
  "NMF_13" = "#d95f02",
  "NMF_14" = "#7570b3",
  "NMF_19" = "#e7298a",
  "NMF_27" = "#66a61e"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 7. Export top-ranked genes per NMF factor
# ============================================================

export_top_genes_long <- function(w,
                                  top_n = 200,
                                  file,
                                  scale01 = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(w)), !is.null(colnames(w)))

  colnames(w) <- sub("^nmf", "NMF_", colnames(w))
  nmfs <- colnames(w)

  out_list <- lapply(nmfs, function(k) {
    v <- w[, k]
    v <- v[is.finite(v)]
    v <- v[order(v, decreasing = TRUE)]
    v <- head(v, top_n)

    df <- tibble::tibble(
      NMF = k,
      Rank = seq_along(v),
      Gene = names(v),
      Loading = as.numeric(v)
    )

    if (scale01) {
      lo <- min(df$Loading, na.rm = TRUE)
      hi <- max(df$Loading, na.rm = TRUE)
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Loading_scaled01 = ifelse(isTRUE(all.equal(lo, hi)), 0, (Loading - lo) / (hi - lo)))
    }
    df
  })

  tab <- dplyr::bind_rows(out_list)
  dir.create(dirname(file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  readr::write_csv(tab, file)
  message("Wrote: ", normalizePath(file, mustWork = FALSE))
  tab
}

top200_long <- export_top_genes_long(
  w,
  top_n = 200,
  file = file.path(TABLES_DIR, "NMF_top200_genes_long.csv"),
  scale01 = TRUE
)

dplyr::count(top200_long, NMF) %>% print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# 9. Collapse NMF factors into broader biological composition classes
# (RESTORED from earlier version -- these factor-index groupings are
# manually curated biological interpretation and are kept EXACTLY as
# originally specified, unchanged.)
# ============================================================

h <- out@h
hsc <- t(scale(t(h),center=FALSE, scale=apply(t(h), 2, sd, na.rm=TRUE)))
hsc <- t(t(hsc)/colSums(hsc)) * 100
hsc[is.na(hsc)] <- 0
sub <- spe[,colnames(hsc)]
composition <- list()
composition[['CAF']] <- colSums(hsc[c(28,11,16,12,20,17,6,3,7,5),])
composition[['Ductal_malignant']] <- colSums(hsc[c(13,14,4,19),])
composition[['B_cells']] <- hsc[30,]
composition[['Endocrine']] <- hsc[c(23),]
composition[['Acinar']] <- colSums(hsc[c(1,8,26),])
composition[['Ductal_normal']] <- hsc[c(9),]
composition[['Myeloid(Macrophages)']] <- hsc[22,]
composition[['Myeloid(C1q_macrophages)']] <- hsc[2,]
composition[['Lymphocytes']] <- hsc[15,]
composition[['Adipocytes']] <- colSums(hsc[c(29,21,25),])
composition[['Muscle']] <- colSums(hsc[c(10,24),])
composition[['Endothelial']] <- hsc[18,]
composition[['Nerve']] <- hsc[27,]
comp <- Reduce(rbind,composition)
rownames(comp) <- names(composition)
compk30 <- t(comp)
compk30 <- as.data.frame(compk30)
compk30$barcode <- rownames(compk30)
write.csv(compk30, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "NMFcomp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# 11. Store NMF-derived compositions and labels in the SpatialExperiment
# object, and save Integrated_NMF.rds
# (RESTORED from earlier version -- this is the file every other script
# in this project reads as its primary input. Saved to input/, not
# output/ or processed/, matching how um_per_pixel_CALIBRATED.rds is
# also treated as a fixed input constant for downstream scripts rather
# than a per-analysis result.)
# ============================================================

stopifnot(identical(colnames(spe),colnames(comp)))

reducedDim(spe,"compk30") <- t(comp)

whichk30 <- lapply(colnames(comp),function(COL) comp[,COL]>50)
spe$k30label <- unlist(lapply(whichk30,function(X) ifelse(sum(X)==0,"Mixed",names(X)[X])))

saveRDS(spe, file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))
cat("Saved final annotated SPE object to:", file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"), "\n")
cat("This file is now the primary input for every downstream analysis script in this project.\n")
```
